Class ShamanicRitualEventCard

java.lang.Object
model.cards.Card
model.cards.TribeCard
model.cards.eventCards.EventCard
model.cards.eventCards.ShamanicRitualEventCard
public class ShamanicRitualEventCard extends EventCard
Represents the global concrete event execution card for the Shamanic Ritual phase.

This event implements a relative performance comparison (majority vs. minority) among all active participants based on their aggregate shamanic star counts. The resolution algorithm evaluates player states dynamically by compounding intrinsic tribal stars with building-derived capabilities (such as flat icon padding, score multiplication, and penalty mitigation flags).

  • Method Details

    • resolve

      public EventResolutionDto resolve(List<Player> players)
      Algorithmic Resolution Pipeline:
      1. Computes the chronological scaling index: eraIndex = era.ordinal() + 1.
      2. Demographic Audit: Iterates through all players to map total shamanic star weights. If a player possesses an active bonus icon flag (Player.hasShamanicBonusIcons()), an additional padding of 3 stars is structurally added to their evaluation tally.
      3. Extrema Identification: Determines the absolute maximum (max) and minimum (min) star metrics present across the global sample.
      4. Mathematical Scale Definition: Defines the reward baseline as eraIndex * 5 and the regression penalty baseline as 3 + (2 * (eraIndex - 1)).
      5. Majority Payload Allocation: Awards the calculated baseline to all players matching the max threshold. If a winning player has the doubling modifier active (Player.hasShamanicDoublePrestige()), the prestige point payload is multiplied by 2.
      6. Minority Penalty Execution: Deducts the regression penalty from all players matching the min threshold, provided they do not possess protective immunity (Player.hasShamanicImmunity()).
      7. State Serialization: Compiles data deltas and performance context labels ("tied", "majority", "minority", "middle") into transportable PlayerEventDeltaDto instances.
      Specified by:
      resolve in class EventCard
      Parameters:
      players - the active list of Player instances participating in the game
      Returns:
      a fully populated, serialized network transport object EventResolutionDto summarizing the phase outcomes
